claims.claim: Mercury Systems reported record Q3 FY26 bookings of $348M (+73.7% YoY), 1.48 book-to-bill and record backlog of about $1.6B (+17.9%), with revenue up 11.5% organically.

factors.name: defense electronics demand visibility
factors.basis: Record bookings and backlog provide forward demand evidence across Mercury's defense electronics portfolio.

risks.risk: Defense program timing and customer concentration can make backlog conversion uneven.

unknowns.unknown: Program-level backlog composition and cancellation/deferral sensitivity are not fully disclosed in this release.

claims.claim: Q3 FY26 adjusted EBITDA rose 46.2% YoY to $36M and revenue rose to $236M, but free cash flow was negative $1.8M versus positive $24.1M a year earlier.

factors.name: operating recovery versus cash conversion
factors.basis: Bookings, revenue and adjusted EBITDA improved materially while quarterly free cash flow weakened.

risks.risk: If cash conversion does not recover alongside backlog growth, earnings-quality expectations should be tempered.

contradictions.claim: Strong operating recovery but weak quarterly free cash flow
contradictions.resolution: Both are retained; backlog/EBITDA strength does not erase working-capital/cash-conversion risk.
